lead_raw_text:
The structure of Cs₂NaSbS₄ crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Imma (No. 216), with a unit cell containing 36 atoms—Cs₈Na₄Sb₄S₁₆—distributed over five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Na and Sb each adopt tetrahedral coordination by four S neighbors, while Cs centers have eight S neighbors and S centers have five geometric neighbors. The connectivity forms a three-dimensional network, and validated polyhedron contacts reveal corner-sharing between Na and Sb tetrahedra, as well as corner- and edge-sharing among Cs 8-vertex polyhedra.
